//: Firebase Hosting for GuardBand's public pages. First deployed 2026-10-11.
/                             - index linking the two pages below, so a
trimmed link does not land on a 404
/.well-known/assetlinks.json  - proves this domain belongs to the app,
which is what makes android:autoVerify
work and opens the password-reset link
in the app with no chooser. The reset
link is Firebase's own handler on
guardband-aae65.firebaseapp.com, which
serves this same site, so this file
has to stay deployed for it.
/privacy                      - the Privacy Notice, linked from the
sign-up consent step and from Settings
/delete-account               - how to delete an account, reachable
without the app on purpose
The ignore list is the important part. Firebase Hosting's default ignore
includes '**/.*', which silently drops every dotfolder - including
.well-known/. Deploying with the default list gives a 404 on assetlinks
and an App Link that never verifies, with nothing in the deploy output to
say why. The list here keeps firebase.json and node_modules out but omits
the dotfile glob on purpose. Do not tidy it back in.
cleanUrls + trailingSlash:false so /privacy and /delete-account are
each served directly, rather than 301-ing to a trailing-slash form.
Neither setting touches assetlinks.json: cleanUrls only strips .html, and
the file is not a directory index. There are no redirects and no rewrites
at all, because assetlinks.json has to be served directly, as
application/json, at exactly that path - a redirect fails verification.
Deploy with:  firebase deploy --only hosting
Checklists: docs/forgot-password.md and docs/privacy-and-consent.md.
